content: Entra device authorization grant: POST https://login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant}/oauth2/v2.0/devicecode with client_id + space-separated scope; tenant is common|consumers|organizations|<guid>. Response: device_code, user_code, verification_uri, expires_in (default 15 min), interval (poll seconds), message (localizable via ?mkt=xx-XX). verification_uri_complete is NOT supported by Microsoft. Poll POST /oauth2/v2.0/token with grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:device_code, client_id, device_code. Polling errors: authorization_pending (retry after >= interval), authorization_declined (stop), bad_verification_code (stop/fix), expired_token (stop). refresh_token is only issued if scope included offline_access. App registration must set allowPublicClient=true ('Allow public client flows' = Yes) or the token endpoint returns AADSTS7000218 demanding client_secret.
